**Reasoning:**
- **Smallest size:** zstd at **6 MB** beats gzip (9 MB) and zip (12 MB) — a 33% reduction over the previous default of gzip.
- **Prior rejection is now stale:** The earlier attempt rejected zstd with the condition *"stale when downstream importer adds tested zstd support."* Today's upgrade of the importer — with all three formats confirmed passing — directly triggers that staleness condition, invalidating the rejection.
- **No remaining blockers:** All three formats pass compatibility tests on the currently deployed importer version, so there is no compatibility risk in switching to zstd.
